And as we scale, the bar for what analytics can deliver is rising fast.We believe AI will fundamentally change the role of the data analyst, and we're looking for a leader who will guide the team through that transition and show us what great looks like.The question is no longer "can you pull this number?" but "what data product do we need to build so no one ever has to ask us again?" Conversational analytics, automated reporting, agentic workflows — these aren't slides in a roadmap deck, they're what you and your team will be shipping.If solving hard technical, organisational, business, and strategic problems excites you — you're in the right place.This role is on-site in Munich, with two office days per week.Our Tech StackDatabase: AWS Stack (Redshift, Athena, Glue, S3)Data Pipelines: Airflow, dbtData Visualisation: LookerData Analytics: SQL, PythonCollaboration: Git, Jira, Confluence, SlackYour role in this journeyYou'll lead one of Holidu's core analytics teams — four analysts today, working alongside data engineering and data science, and serving stakeholders across Customer Support, Host Experience, Sales, and Account Management. It's a role with real surface area: the problems are messy, the stakeholders are senior, and the decisions you influence show up in the P&L.Concretely, You WillLead from the front. This isn't a role where you stop doing the work. You'll be deep in agentic programming, exploring our data, and setting the bar for what great analytics looks like — both technically and in how we frame problems. If you've stopped enjoying the craft, this won't be the right fit.Build the analyst of 2027, not 2023. Conversational interfaces, automated insights, decision systems — the category is wide open and we're betting on it.Sit at the strategy table. As part of the BI leadership team, you'll shape the department's direction and represent analytics in the conversations that matter — product strategy, commercial planning, the road to IPO and beyond.Develop people who'll out-grow you. This is a leadership role; the multiplier matters more than your individual output.Your backpack is filled with5+ years of data analytics experience.Previous people management experience, with the proven ability to mentor and grow talent.A collaborative mindset with clear experience communicating with executive stakeholders and senior decision makers.A mission-driven, working-backwards mentality, starting from customer and business needs, managing complex multi-stakeholder projects, and translating goals into analytical solutions and actionable insights.Excellent analytical and technical skills: strong SQL, Python (or similar), data visualisation, and the ability to develop technical frameworks that serve a clear business need.A genuine commitment to AI enablement, you actively use tools like Claude Code or similar to enhance your own coding, planning, and workflows, and you're excited to bring your team along. AI fluency is not a nice-to-have here, it's part of how we work and how we evaluate impact.Our adventure includesImpact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets - with a strong focus on AI.Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts - people we can all relate to - making work meaningful and energizing.Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized - but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.Need a sneak peek?Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholidu and dive straight into the world of Tech at Holidu for more insights!Want to travel with us? You'll be joining and leading the analytics team at a pivotal moment. At Holidu, data isn't a support function — it's how the company decides. And as we scale, the bar for what analytics can deliver is rising fast.


We believe AI will fundamentally change the role of the data analyst, and we're looking for a leader who will guide the team through that transition and show us what great looks like.

The question is no longer "can you pull this number?" but "what data product do we need to build so no one ever has to ask us again?" Conversational analytics, automated reporting, agentic workflows — these aren't slides in a roadmap deck, they're what you and your team will be shipping.


If solving hard technical, organisational, business, and strategic problems excites you — you're in the right place.


This role is on-site in Munich, with two office days per week.


Our Tech Stack

  • Database: AWS Stack (Redshift, Athena, Glue, S3)
  • Data Pipelines: Airflow, dbt
  • Data Visualisation: Looker
  • Data Analytics: SQL, Python
  • Collaboration: Git, Jira, Confluence, Slack


Your role in this journey

You'll lead one of Holidu's core analytics teams — four analysts today, working alongside data engineering and data science, and serving stakeholders across Customer Support, Host Experience, Sales, and Account Management. It's a role with real surface area: the problems are messy, the stakeholders are senior, and the decisions you influence show up in the P&L.

Concretely, You Will

  • Lead from the front. This isn't a role where you stop doing the work. You'll be deep in agentic programming, exploring our data, and setting the bar for what great analytics looks like — both technically and in how we frame problems. If you've stopped enjoying the craft, this won't be the right fit.
  • Build the analyst of 2027, not 2023. You'll help define what AI-native analytics looks like in practice at Holidu — the tools, the workflows, the standards, the rituals. Your team will use Claude, Cursor, and whatever comes next as core instruments, not novelties. You should already be doing this yourself.
  • Ship products, not reports. Partner with stakeholders to identify the recurring questions, the broken workflows, the decisions made on gut, and turn them into analytical products that scale. Conversational interfaces, automated insights, decision systems — the category is wide open and we're betting on it.
  • Sit at the strategy table. As part of the BI leadership team, you'll shape the department's direction and represent analytics in the conversations that matter — product strategy, commercial planning, the road to IPO and beyond.
  • Develop people who'll out-grow you. Hire well, set sharp goals, give honest feedback, and build a team that people want to join and stay on. This is a leadership role; the multiplier matters more than your individual output.


Your backpack is filled with

  • 5+ years of data analytics experience.
  • Previous people management experience, with the proven ability to mentor and grow talent.
  • A collaborative mindset with clear experience communicating with executive stakeholders and senior decision makers.
  • A mission-driven, working-backwards mentality, starting from customer and business needs, managing complex multi-stakeholder projects, and translating goals into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
  • Excellent analytical and technical skills: strong SQL, Python (or similar), data visualisation, and the ability to develop technical frameworks that serve a clear business need.
  • A genuine commitment to AI enablement, you actively use tools like Claude Code or similar to enhance your own coding, planning, and workflows, and you're excited to bring your team along. AI fluency is not a nice-to-have here, it's part of how we work and how we evaluate impact.


Our adventure includes

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters - and you’ll see the impact.
  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets - with a strong focus on AI.
  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts - people we can all relate to - making work meaningful and energizing.
  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
  • Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
  • Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized - but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.


Need a sneak peek?

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholidu and dive straight into the world of Tech at Holidu for more insights!


Want to travel with us?

Apply online on our careers page! Your first travel contact will be Katharina from HR.


We are committed to diversity in all aspects of our business. We encourage applications from all genders, all corners of the world and all individual backgrounds. You are welcome to submit your application without a photo and without stating your gender, date of birth, marital status, nationality or disability status (if applicable). If you require any special assistance when arranging interviews, office visits or the recruitment process in general, please contact the relevant HR person responsible for this job and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.

Location Munich, Germany

BIRKENSTOCK is a global brand which embraces all consumers regardless of geography, gender, age and income. To ensure our quality standards, we produce over 95% of our products in Germany and source more than 90% of our materials and components from Europe. The BIRKENSTOCK Group is headquartered in Linz am Rhein and maintains several locations in Germany, as well as sales offices in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end onsite analytics framework and KPI architecture across the customer journey, from homepage engagement and product exploration through checkout, purchase, and account creation.

  • Contribute to analytics governance, KPI standardization, and data quality initiatives in collaboration with the wider Analytics team.

  • Share analytical best practices and guide stakeholders on data interpretation and usage.
  • Support capability building and knowledge sharing across Digital, Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams, including stakeholder training on reporting tools and analytics capabilities.
  • Leverage Digital analysis and insights to support other areas of the business, including Membership, Strategy, and Retail.


Your Experience And Competencies

  • Experience in Analytics and strong analytical skills and knowledge.
  • Experience in Retail, E-commerce, FMCG, or Fashion.
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong analytical mindset.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage and prioritize tasks and strategic priorities.
  • Stakeholder and project management skills.
  • Willingness to learn and develop both technically and strategically.
  • Motivation to work in a dynamic, diverse, and international environment.
  • Experience with Google, Adobe Analytics, and Contentsquare.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, including Tableau and Looker.
  • SQL and/or Python skills, including PySpark and Pandas.
  • Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
  • Fluent English.


We Offer

BIRKENSTOCK offers you all the advantages of a successful, fast growing, global company: dynamic work environment, considerable design freedom, authentic and open corporate culture and excellent development opportunities. title: Chief AI Officer (m/w/d)
description: Wir denken an die Zukunft  – auch an Deine. Als Chief AI Officer verantwortest Du unsere unternehmensweite KI- und Analytics-Strategie sowie die Führung der unserer neu geschaffenen AI-Organisation. Dein Ziel ist die nachhaltige Wertschöpfung aus Daten und KI durch die Priorisierung und Umsetzung sowie Weiterentwicklung von KI-Initiativen, den Aufbau der notwendigen Fähigkeiten und Plattformen sowie die Sicherstellung einer wirksamen KI-Governance und eines verantwortungsvollen und regelkonformen KI-Einsatzes.Was Du bei uns bewegst Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer unternehmensweiten KI- und Analytics-Strategie, die konsequent auf die Geschäftsziele und die Transformation von Speira einzahlt. Identifikation und Priorisierung von KI-Anwendungsfeldern mit hohem Geschäftswert sowie Steuerung eines unternehmensweiten Use-Case-Portfolios. Beratung von Vorstand, Management und Fachbereichen zu KI-Potenzialen, strategischen Prioritäten und Investitionsentscheidungen. Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren KI-Operating-Models mit klaren Governance-, Rollen- und Entscheidungsstrukturen. Verantwortung für die zentrale Daten- und KI-Plattform sowie für die technologischen und organisatorischen Grundlagen einer erfolgreichen KI-Nutzung. Sicherstellung einer verantwortungsvollen, sicheren und regulatorisch konformen Anwendung von KI, einschließlich Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und EU AI Act. Führung und Weiterentwicklung der KI-Organisation sowie Förderung von Talenten, Kompetenzen und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Treiber einer daten- und KI-getriebenen Unternehmenskultur durch Wissenstransfer, Enablement und die Skalierung erfolgreicher KI-Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen. Was Dich auszeichnet Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium der Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mehr als 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung daten- und KI-getriebener Organisationen sowie in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung strategischer Transformationsinitiativen. Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Technologien, Machine Learning, Generative AI sowie Daten- und Cloud-Plattformen Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams sowie in der Entwicklung leistungsstarker Organisationen und Talente. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, zwischen Business und Technologie zu vermitteln, kombiniert mit exzellenten Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills auf C-Level-Ebene. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Vorständen und Führungskräften sowie im Business Enablement zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Skalierung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen. Hands-on-Mentalität mit der Fähigkeit, strategische Leitplanken zu setzen, gleichzeitig aber auch aktiv an der Gestaltung von Strukturen, Prozessen, Governance-Modellen und Betriebsmodellen mitzuwirken. Starker Fokus auf Wertschöpfung und Geschäftswirkung mit fundierter Erfahrung in Value Tracking, Benefit Realization und der Identifikation nachhaltiger Wachstums- und Effizienzpotenziale durch Daten und KI. Wir betonen ausdrücklich, dass bei uns alle Menschen - unabhängig von Geschlecht/geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder Gleichstellung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung - gleichermaßen willkommen sind.Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten und gleichgestellten behinderten Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung berücksichtigt.Dein Interesse ist geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! BewerbungsschlussAnsprechperson: Phillip VojinovicDu hast noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deinen Anruf unter: +49 2181 477 3008

  • Treiber einer daten- und KI-getriebenen Unternehmenskultur durch Wissenstransfer, Enablement und die Skalierung erfolgreicher KI-Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen.

Was Dich auszeichnet

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium der Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mehr als 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung daten- und KI-getriebener Organisationen sowie in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung strategischer Transformationsinitiativen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Technologien, Machine Learning, Generative AI sowie Daten- und Cloud-Plattformen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams sowie in der Entwicklung leistungsstarker Organisationen und Talente.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, zwischen Business und Technologie zu vermitteln, kombiniert mit exzellenten Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills auf C-Level-Ebene.
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Vorständen und Führungskräften sowie im Business Enablement zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Skalierung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität mit der Fähigkeit, strategische Leitplanken zu setzen, gleichzeitig aber auch aktiv an der Gestaltung von Strukturen, Prozessen, Governance-Modellen und Betriebsmodellen mitzuwirken.
  • Starker Fokus auf Wertschöpfung und Geschäftswirkung mit fundierter Erfahrung in Value Tracking, Benefit Realization und der Identifikation nachhaltiger Wachstums- und Effizienzpotenziale durch Daten und KI.

Wir betonen ausdrücklich, dass bei uns alle Menschen - unabhängig von Geschlecht/geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder Gleichstellung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung - gleichermaßen willkommen sind.

Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten und gleichgestellten behinderten Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung berücksichtigt.

descriptionHtml:
(Senior) Team Lead Data Analytics | Munich | on-site 2 days/week


One of Europe's fastest-growing travel tech scaleups is looking for a senior analytics leader to own one of their core BI teams. It's a real IC responsibility, strategic visibility, and a genuine seat at the table.


The role:

  • Lead a team of 4 direct reports within the Business Intelligence department
  • You'll help define what AI-native analytics looks like in practice: the tools, the workflows, the standards, the rituals. Your team will use Claude, Cursor, and whatever comes next as core instruments, not novelties. You should already be doing this yourself.
  • Engage with senior leadership on strategic projects influencing product strategy, internal operations, and revenue growth
  • Support stakeholders across Customer Support, Host Experience, Sales, and Account Management
  • Translate complex, multi-stakeholder problems into analytical requirements and communicate findings to both technical and commercial audiences
  • Do real analytical work: this is a hands-on lead role, not just a people manager title
  • Help shape BI department strategy and the future of AI-powered data products
  • Recruit top talent, set clear goals, and develop your team personally and professionally


Stack: AWS (Redshift, Athena, Glue, S3) · dbt · Airflow · Looker · SQL · Python · Git · Jira


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of data analytics experience
  • Prior people management, this should not be your first leadership role
  • Track record of communicating with executive stakeholders and senior decision makers
  • Mission-driven, working-backwards mentality: start from business needs, deliver actionable insights
  • Strong SQL, Python (or similar), and data visualisation skills
  • Genuine AI fluency: active use of tools like Claude Code or similar is part of how they evaluate impact, not a nice-to-have


Why it's worth a look:

  • The company treats data as a core decision-making function, not a support layer.
  • You'll work on products used by millions of guests and tens of thousands of hosts, with fast iteration cycles and real learning opportunities.
  • Up to 8 weeks/year working from another location is part of the deal.


📍 Munich | Hybrid (2 office days/week) | International team, 60+ nationalities

Interested or know someone who might be? DM me.
